name: Проклятие! Золото дураков
alt: Сокровище оказалось блестящими фантиками и покрашенными камнями.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, clear at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky forms, strong silhouette. Centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, not copied card art. Clear plausible anatomy, no unintended extra limbs. Subject: One open wooden treasure chest full of shiny gold-painted pebbles and crumpled yellow wrappers, one peeled gold foil revealing an ordinary gray rock. A tiny gray mouse holds a magnifying glass toward the fake treasure with a skeptical raised brow. Mouse two front paws two hind paws one tail. No coins with letters, no text, simple clear chest and bright false riches.
